lines.zh: 张开大嘴，露出锋利牙齿。

lines.en: Stare at prey, ready to pounce.
Use back legs to push forward.

lines.zh: 舌头快速舔动，嗅探猎物。
发出低沉吼声，警告入侵者。
肚子贴着石头滑过去，鳞片不响。
lines.en: My belly slides over the stone without a sound.

lines.zh: 爪子抓着地面，把土翻起来。
lines.en: My claws dig in and turn up the soil.

lines.zh: 我抬着头走，舌头一直在动。
lines.en: I walk with my head high, tongue always working.

lines.zh: 尾尖拖地，扫出一条浅痕。
lines.en: My tail tip drags, sweeping a shallow line.

lines.zh: 四肢撑起身体，肚皮离地。
lines.en: My legs lift my body, belly off the ground.

lines.zh: 从石头上翻过去，鳞片擦响。
lines.en: I climb over the rock, scales scraping.
Each step is slow, but heavy.

lines.zh: 闭上眼睛，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Close eyes, enjoying a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 放松肌肉，缓缓打量环境。
lines.en: Relax muscles, slowly surveying the area.

lines.zh: 偶尔打个哈欠，伸展身体。
我把下巴搁在石头上晒着。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the stone to bask.

lines.zh: 舌头收回去，慢慢咽口水。
lines.en: My tongue retracts and I swallow slowly.
The burrow is stuffy, so I pant with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 一动不动的样子，像块石头。
lines.en: Lying still, I look like a rock.

lines.zh: 盯紧目标，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Fixed on target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 喉咙发出咕噜声，锁定猎物。
发出嘶嘶声，警告你靠近。
lines.en: Hisses, warning you to stay back.

lines.zh: 牙齿咯吱作响，准备捕猎。
目光紧盯着你，威胁意味浓厚。
缓缓爬行，接近你的脚步。
我的唾液比咬痕更麻烦。
lines.en: My saliva is worse than the bite.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中传来低沉的呻吟
lines.en: A deep hiss followed by a groan

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声与痛苦的哀鸣交织
lines.en: Heavy footsteps mix with a mournful cry

lines.zh: 缓慢地爬行，发出嘶嘶声

lines.en: A painful cry, laced with anger

lines.zh: 挣扎中发出低沉的呼噜声
呻吟中带着死亡的气息
lines.en: A groan with a hint of death

lines.zh: 巨大的嘴巴张开，露出锋利的牙齿！
lines.en: The huge mouth opens, revealing sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 你看起来像个美味的猎物！
lines.en: You look like a delicious meal!
Come closer, I want to taste you!
Venom is pooling under my tongue. Come here.
I can hunt with my tongue!

lines.zh: 科莫多式的牙，咬一口就够。
我的牙带毒，你闻到了吗？
lines.en: My bite is venomous. Smell that?

lines.zh: 舌信一吐一收，我在量你的距离。
lines.en: My tongue flicks in and out, measuring the gap.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的尾尖，别怪我。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail tip; do not blame me.
I won't make way for you!
I warn you, don't get close!
My bite is venomous. Stay back.

lines.zh: 你有资格成为我的配偶吗？
lines.en: Are you worthy of being my mate?

lines.zh: 挖好的土坑里，我等你过来。
lines.en: In the burrow I dug, I wait for you.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味我认下了。
嘶嘶作响，皮肤粗糙如岩壁。
lines.en: Sssss, skin as rough as rocks.

lines.zh: 盯着你，仿佛洞悉了未来。
lines.en: Staring at you, seeing your future.

lines.zh: 尖锐的牙齿，致命的武器。
幼体警惕，不敢轻举妄动。
爪子锋利，轻易撕裂猎物。
喉咙发出嘶嘶声，警告入侵者。
在岩石中埋伏，静待猎物。
lines.en: Ambushing in rocks, waiting for prey.
Locking on you, tracking your scent.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一根枯枝，我听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a dry twig; I heard it.
Acquired your scent, you can't escape.
One bite of mine carries seven points of venom.
My venomous fangs are already dripping.
My venom gland wakes before my teeth.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤口，那就更好。
lines.en: You already have a wound; even better.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，从草缝里看你。
lines.en: Head low, I watch you through the grass.
Aiming at you, ready to kill.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备一击毙命。

lines.en: Aiming at you, for the kill.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫开枯叶，我朝你爬。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the dead leaves aside as I crawl at you.
The target holds still; I move first.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，贴住地面。
lines.en: I flatten my body against the ground.
Venom pools at the base of my teeth.
One step back from you, and I pounce.

lines.zh: 我的头已经对准你的小腿。
lines.en: My head is already aimed at your calf.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，巨舌舔舐猎物。
lines.en: Hisss, long tongue licks the prey.

lines.zh: 利齿咬破皮肤，毒液注入。
lines.en: Sharp teeth tear flesh, venom injected.
One bite, and the venom goes in with it!

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在你膝上，站不稳了！
lines.en: My tail cracks your knee and you stagger!
Leap from shadows,扑向猎物 jump at prey.

lines.zh: 潜伏于岩石后，静候时机。
lines.en: Lurk behind rocks, wait for chance.

lines.zh: 在洞穴中沉睡，伺机而动。
lines.en: Snooze in caves, wait to strike.
Appear at night, easier to catch.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴深处爬出来，爪子先到。
lines.en: I crawl from the deep burrow, claws first.

lines.zh: 化石里的基因，把我拼了起来。
lines.en: Genes from the fossil pieced me together.

lines.zh: 我伏在灌木后，只露出头顶。
lines.en: I lie behind the shrubs with only my head showing.

lines.zh: 巨蜥的体型，一出生就这么大。
lines.en: A monitor lizard, this big from birth.
A torn cry as it falls

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击撕裂了我的皮肉
lines.en: The blast tears at my flesh
A spell tears at my skin
